task: Add fail-closed Plan Before Code support for executor-derived metadata-only parent closure projections without permitting ordinary empty plans.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Release Unit Execution #296 reaches the executor-derived parent closure proof plan but Plan Before Code necessarily rejects it with DEV_PLAN_PROJECTION_EMPTY because `quality/development/active-plan.json` is intentionally excluded from material projectedFiles. The derived plan also currently inherits source-plan material scope metadata, causing domain/authority/failure/digest drift even though the closure transaction is metadata-only. Ordinary empty plans must remain blocked. The planner therefore needs a narrowly authenticated metadata-only projection mode tied to the existing parentClosureContext contract, and the derived closure-plan builder must normalize material scope fields to the canonical empty projection.
observableOutcomes: Ordinary plans with no material projected files still fail with DEV_PLAN_PROJECTION_EMPTY.
Only a plan carrying a valid executor-derived parentClosureContext/proofPlanContract and exactly the development metadata path may enter metadata-only projection mode.

Metadata-only projection requires plannedFilePatterns exactly [`quality/development/active-plan.json`], no material mustEdit/mustCreate/planned deletion/rename/generated-artifact obligations, and no material changedFiles.

The derived parent closure-plan builder normalizes expectedSubsystems, expectedDomains, expectedAuthorities, expectedKnownFailureIds, acknowledgedNegativeKnowledgeIds and acknowledgedPoInstructionIds to the canonical empty material projection.
The derived builder computes the canonical empty guardDigest using the same stableDigest algorithm as Plan Before Code, not a hard-coded constant.
The semantic execution route remains explicit and closure-only: metadata mayEdit/proof is allowed, material mustEdit/mustCreate remain empty, unknown remains empty.
Plan Before Code reports a distinct evaluation mode/flag for authenticated metadata-only parent closure rather than pretending a material projection exists.
Gate-chain compilation still includes explicitly required completion guards even when projectedFiles is empty.
No product/domain/authority/failure scope is inferred from metadata-only closure.
Forged parentClosureContext, extra planned material files, non-empty material operations, stale finalMain binding, or wrong proofPlanContract keep the plan blocked.
Immutable rehearsal replay advances beyond #296's DEV_PLAN_PROJECTION_EMPTY / scope-drift blocker without changing source plan or canonical state manually.
unresolvedRisks: A broad 'allow empty projection' exception could let arbitrary plans bypass planning.
Trusting only the presence of parentClosureContext without contract/shape checks could be forged.
Normalizing expected scope in the planner instead of the builder could hide malformed derived plans.
A metadata-only plan with hidden material semantic-route obligations could still become a scope bypass.
Changing projectedFiles semantics globally could alter release decomposition for ordinary plans.
A mismatch between runtime and planner stableDigest implementations could create permanent drift.

in: Add a pure predicate/validator for authenticated parent metadata-only closure projection in Plan Before Code.
Keep projectedFiles materially empty in this mode; do not inject a fake source/test/runtime file.
Suppress DEV_PLAN_PROJECTION_EMPTY only for the authenticated metadata-only closure contract.
Require canonical empty material scope/digest declarations from the derived plan.
Preserve explicit completion guard-chain compilation from completionContract even with zero material projected files.
Add positive and adversarial regression coverage in shoperation-development-guard and release-unit orchestration tests.
out: No change to immutable source branch or canonical release-state.
No weakening of Plan Before Code for ordinary plans.
No fake planned material file or no-op implementation commit.
No removal of active-plan metadata exclusion from general projectedFiles.
No edit to receipt-bound production-surface test.
No change to trusted-main reconciliation, child close receipts, workflow triggers, storefront, Builder, database or deployment.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This is an exception to the planner's empty-projection invariant. It must be narrowly bound to an already authenticated executor-derived closure context so it cannot become a generic planning bypass.

acceptanceCriteria: DEV_PLAN_PROJECTION_EMPTY remains emitted for a normal plan whose only planned path is active-plan metadata.
A valid parent closure proof plan with zero material projected files does not emit DEV_PLAN_PROJECTION_EMPTY.
Metadata-only mode requires semantic route material mutation arrays mustEdit/mustCreate/plannedDeletions/plannedRenames/generatedArtifacts all empty.
Metadata-only mode requires no material actual diff between changeBaseSha and exact head.
Planner still compiles explicit completion guards and produces a PASS gate chain for valid metadata-only closure.
Forged context or any extra material planned path is BLOCK.
Exact-head CI, Completion Truth and Lifecycle Closure pass before merge.
invariants: Development metadata is not material implementation.
Metadata-only projection is valid only for executor-derived parent closure.
No ordinary plan can self-authorize by planning only its own active-plan file.
The derived closure plan remains state-bound through parentClosureContext validation elsewhere.
Material release decomposition remains unchanged for all non-metadata-only plans.

failureModes: Parent closure context is missing or malformed.
plannedFilePatterns contains an additional material file.
derived material scope fields are inherited from source plan instead of normalized.
guardDigest is not the canonical empty-scope digest.
completion guard chain becomes empty because projectedFiles is empty.
ordinary metadata-only plan accidentally enters the exception path.
edgeCases: Valid metadata-only derived plan before lifecycle close.
Same plan after lifecycle is emitted closed.
No trusted-main advance versus trusted-main advance present in parentClosureContext.
Completion contract contains explicit guards while projectedFiles is empty.
Source plan contains 49 historical known-failure IDs but derived closure plan correctly declares zero material failure scope.
A material file is actually changed in worktree despite metadata-only declaration.

alternatives.summary: Teach Plan Before Code one strict executor-derived metadata-only closure mode and normalize the derived plan to canonical empty material scope.
alternatives.reason: Represents the real closure transaction without fake implementation scope and preserves ordinary fail-closed planning.

alternatives.summary: Add a test or proof file to plannedFilePatterns only to make projectedFiles non-empty.
alternatives.reason: Would create false material intent and distort release risk/scope.

alternatives.summary: Stop excluding active-plan.json from projectedFiles for every plan.
alternatives.reason: Would allow plans to use their own metadata as material scope evidence and weaken planning semantics globally.

alternatives.summary: Bypass Plan Before Code during parent closure.
alternatives.reason: Violates the accepted full gate chain.

specialistReviews.finding: The current planner has no representable valid metadata-only development transaction because it deliberately excludes active-plan metadata from material projection.
specialistReviews.resolution: Add one explicit contract-bound metadata-only projection state rather than fabricating material scope.

specialistReviews.finding: Any empty-projection exception is a potential planning bypass.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require exact parent closure context contracts, exact metadata-only path set, zero material mutations and zero actual material diff.

specialistReviews.finding: Derived scope declarations must reflect the closure transaction, not inherited historical source-plan scope.
specialistReviews.resolution: Normalize material scope arrays and guard digest in the builder and assert exact canonical values in the planner.

specialistReviews.finding: Explicit completion guards must still run even with no material projected files.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep compileGateChain explicit guard IDs from completionContract and regression-test ordered gate chain is non-empty/PASS.

specialistReviews.finding: The blocker is deterministic and now recorded under #1129.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require immutable replay to advance beyond the exact #296 error set before closure is accepted.

challenge.scenario: Any plan with only active-plan.json is allowed.
challenge.finding: Generic self-authorizing plans bypass material planning.
Projected material failure scope is empty and drifts.
Empty material projection cannot prove historical ownership.
challenge.resolution: Normalize all material scope arrays to [].

challenge.scenario: Planner treats active-plan.json itself as projected material.
challenge.finding: Self-metadata becomes evidence and affects decomposition/risk.
challenge.resolution: Keep active-plan excluded; represent mode explicitly instead.

challenge.scenario: Metadata-only route includes a runtime file in mustEdit.
challenge.finding: Hidden implementation can slip through empty projection.
challenge.resolution: Metadata mode requires all material mutation route arrays empty.

challenge.scenario: Worktree has an actual material diff even though plan claims metadata-only.
Completion guards disappear because no projected files exist.
challenge.resolution: Explicit completion guards remain compiled and tested.

challenge.scenario: Forged context uses correct contract strings but unrelated task/final main.
challenge.finding: Planner alone cannot validate canonical state identity.
challenge.resolution: Planner restricts mode structurally; runtime builder/validator remains authoritative for context identity before parent close acceptance.

proofPlan: Commit this plan only and require canonical Plan Before Code PASS before implementation.
Add a narrowly scoped metadata-only parent closure projection predicate in shoperation-plan-before-code.mjs.
Normalize derived closure material scope declarations and guardDigest in buildReleaseParentClosureProofPlan using canonical stableDigest semantics.
Keep active-plan.json excluded from general projectedFiles and keep DEV_PLAN_PROJECTION_EMPTY for every non-authorized empty plan.
Add planner regressions for valid metadata-only closure, ordinary empty plan, forged context, extra material path, hidden material route and actual material diff.
Add orchestration regression proving derived closure plan carries canonical empty material scope while preserving immutable completionContract/context.
Open/reuse DRAFT PR only after exact push-head proof, then require exact PR-head SUCCESS and expected-head merge.
Require post-merge main CI SUCCESS on the merge SHA with Quality, TypeScript and Production Build all successful before replay.

Replay immutable source SHA 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65 and require Release Unit Execution to advance beyond all #296 metadata-projection codes; any new blocker remains fail-closed and returns to Failure Intake.

requirements.requirement: Plan Before Code must represent executor-derived parent closure as an authenticated metadata-only transaction without converting empty projection into a generic bypass.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Ordinary empty material projections may not pass Plan Before Code.
Parent closure may not add fake material files merely to satisfy projection.
Metadata-only closure may not contain material mutation obligations or actual material diff.
Derived closure may not inherit historical material scope declarations from the immutable source plan.

notes: Live blocker: main 56ef5edb77f1408f27218892fa58a94189982728; immutable source 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65; Release Unit Execution #296 FAIL. Derived parent closure authority is active, but Plan Before Code intentionally excludes quality/development/active-plan.json from material projectedFiles and therefore emits DEV_PLAN_PROJECTION_EMPTY plus scope/digest/route drift for a legitimate metadata-only closure transaction. Issue #1129 records the exact error set. This transaction adds a contract-bound metadata-only projection mode and keeps every ordinary empty projection fail-closed.
